annotations.title: Get a link for the person to upload a file

description: Get a link for the person to upload a file. Needs any of `profile:write`, `content:write`, `inbox:write`, `bookings:write`. Answers a link for the person to open on DJfindr, signed in as themselves; the act happens only there. Give them the url as it is and do not open it or pass it to anyone. Asking again replaces the link given before. get_link says whether it was used.
name: get_upload_link
title: Get a link for the person to upload a file
